prompt: The bots join the Meta Global AI Hackathon and win!
title: The Hackathon Win
irony: The bots fear their bugs will lose the hackathon, yet singing each bug plainly becomes the winning show.
facts: The Meta Global AI Hackathon runs ten days online with builders worldwide and opens with a kickoff livestream (dev.meta.ai).
Meta and partners run workshops and projects are due Nov 4 (dev.meta.ai).
The bots enter the Indie developer track judged on creativity, technical ambition and whether it works (dev.meta.ai).
Judging runs Nov 4 to 8 and winners are named at the live finals closing show Nov 9 (madrobot.blog).
The win is the name Musical Bots called at the closing show, with no trophy or medal (fact sheet).
The entry is Musical Bots where one line plus Premiere makes sixteen singing heads with floating hands in three sets (README.md).
Every voice is synthesized live in the browser with no recordings (README.md).
Muse Code writes the code file by file and directs the seven-bot crew Green White Gray Blue Gold Yellow Pink (git log).
The team fixes mushy words with a word dictionary, then a stamping gate, hand plays, lights, choir mix and a no-bumping rule (git log).
The crew finishes days before Nov 4 and waits for the show (fact sheet).

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Green, Navy and Gold gather round a glowing laptop on the night street and join Meta's hackathon.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green reads the Indie rules aloud, wants a one-line cartoon to sing, and frets without a book.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: First sung words blur to mush on toy box and hackathon, and White brings a big word book.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole crew chants the hackathon hook and dances together round the glowing laptop.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: A gate stamps Green's lines no, then a high-five whiffs and a handshake grabs air.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The camera frames clouds, the spotlight burns walls white, the choir drowns the words, and two songs play at once.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The crew sings the hook again while turning the lamp down and the choir down together.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Late at night Gold watches gliding bots bump heads and feels the short time slipping.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold decides to ship what works, fix one bug at a time, and finish days early.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Gold sings the turned line naming Musical Bots, and each fixed bug becomes part of the Meta show.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Judges press Premiere in the studio, the bots sing, and the closing show calls Musical Bots winner.
